Jim's effort was superb, the only other veterans to run faster times being Invicta's Mike Gratton (18:51) and Cambridge Harrier's Alan Camp (18:56), while Julian Goater could only offer a 19:08.

The Autumn saw a wonderful series of performances from Jim. 60th in the Great North run in 70:38, an 18:57 relay leg for the senior team at Aldershot in the South of England 6-Stage, a time which would have placed him second only to Mike Gratton if he had run in the Veterans race.
